item.title: GeoLibre Releases Pure-Rust Geospatial Toolkit Compiled to WebAssembly
item.description:
GeoLibre Releases Pure-Rust Geospatial Toolkit Compiled to WebAssembly

GeoLibre has released a new pure-Rust geospatial toolkit compiled to WebAssembly, enabling client-side geospatial processing without requiring servers, native installations, or GDAL dependencies. The toolkit is available as an npm package (geolibre-wasm) and PyPI package (geolibre-wasm) and ships with both the existing whitebox-wasm tools and new GeoLibre-authored tools located in the geolibre-tools crate. The release includes a self-contained demo page that loads all tool manifests and allows users to run geoprocessing on sample or custom GeoTIFF files entirely in the browser, with support for viewing exit codes, stdout, output files, and download links.

#GeoLibre #WebAssembly #Geospatial #Rust #GIS #SpatialAnalysis

Source: opengeos/geolibre-rust

item.title: Datasette-cluster-map plugin updated to version 0.19
item.description:
Datasette-cluster-map plugin updated to version 0.19

On 13th November 2026, version 0.19 of the datasette-cluster-map plugin was released. This tool provides mapping capabilities for datasets containing latitude and longitude columns.

⚙️ Key details

  • Compatibility: Updated to support Datasette 1.0a42.
  • Dependencies: Now relies on datasette-leaflet to manage OpenStreetMap tile requests, specifically ensuring they include a referrer header.
  • Functionality: Displays a map for any data with latitude and longitude columns.

#Datasette #OpenStreetMap #DataVisualization #GIS

Source: Release: datasette-cluster-map 0.19
